subject.title: fix(models): preserve static provider catalog metadata

question: Should existing provider-level `params` begin applying to static provider catalog models, with model-level values taking precedence?
rationale: The behavior matches the typed provider/model configuration contract and fixes metadata loss, but it intentionally activates request defaults that existing static-catalog configurations previously ignored.

options.title: Accept inherited provider defaults
options.body: Land provider params as defaults beneath model params after rebased compatibility-focused validation.

options.title: Keep static catalogs model-only
options.body: Decline provider-param inheritance and narrow or close the PR rather than activating the existing defaults.

recommendation.title: Accept inherited provider defaults
recommendation.body: Land provider params as defaults beneath model params after rebased compatibility-focused validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history signal spans the static catalog converter, inline model normalization, and downstream OpenAI transport behavior.
